bullets.text: VMO2 Launches Giga Sites - **VMO2** unveils its first Giga Site in London, enhancing **5G** connectivity across the UK.
BritCard Faces Trust Issues - The UK's proposed digital ID, **BritCard**, struggles with public trust amid privacy concerns.
Telecom Strategies Needed - Multifamily property owners report gaps in telecom strategies, impacting resident satisfaction.
AI Integration in 3GPP - **3GPP Release 19** introduces AI to enhance **5G** network performance and efficiency.
Taliban's Telecom Blackout - A nationwide telecom blackout in Afghanistan severely disrupts communication and essential services.
Samsung Partners with Vodafone - **Samsung** to supply **Vodafone** with O-RAN solutions, enhancing network capabilities across Europe.
Connectivity Gaps Persist - A survey reveals significant connectivity issues in U.S. households, impacting customer satisfaction.
Telephony Constraints for Businesses - Geographically-bound telephony limits global business efficiency and communication.
Huawei Cloud's AI Innovations - **Huawei Cloud** announces advancements in AI compute services to support industry applications.
Optus Network Outage - **Optus** experiences another outage, impacting customer access to emergency services.
